literal_meaning: মাপা এবং জোখা (precise measurement and division)
figurative_meaning_en: Something that has been precisely measured or divided
example_sentences_in_bangla: সম্পত্তির মাপজোখ হয়ে গেছে, এখন ভাগ বাটোয়ারা করা যাবে।
এই চুক্তিটি মাপজোখ করে করা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The property has been measured and divided, now it can be partitioned.
This agreement has been precisely measured out.
note: Refers to traditional practices of land measurement in Bengali agrarian society
